registered_rule: Same model form (home constant + 32 club margin effects, ridge lambda 2.0), identical training windows. Arm A = published ratings only; Arm B = identical ratings plus the two official availability-load features (0-4 scale, derived from the official injury report joined to club depth charts). MAE delta > 0 means the availability arm is closer to the truth. Paired bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261115.
caveat: Availability snapshots exist only for weeks 8-10, so the ablation trains on very few weeks and its confidence intervals are wide. The interval - not a point estimate - is the published result; the panel becomes decisive only when the snapshot history spans more weeks (RD-06).
